title: The Premier minister of the state
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：premier　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 premier 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the fisherman wrote of ① a premier minister of the state in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② so premier that nobody in the harbour would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the premier ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the premier minister of the state that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too premier to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the premier ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a premier team of the league, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as premier as the team of the league they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was premier or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something premier, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite premier; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the premier ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, twice over, she wrote of another premier minister of the state in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less premier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The premier team of the league that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the premier ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 首要（前置定语 a premier minister of the state：1950 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件首要的首相）
B. adj. 首要／最负盛名（两处加强说法：so premier that … 与 no less premier than …）
C. adj. 首要／最负盛名（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 首要（表语 too premier to do：母亲觉得它太首要，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 最负盛名（前置定语 a premier team of the league：叔叔把整件事称作一桩最负盛名的头名球队）
F. adj. 最负盛名（同级比较 as premier as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩联赛中的头名球队相比）
G. adj. 最负盛名（后置定语 something premier：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 最负盛名（受程度副词修饰 quite premier：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a premier minister of the state
the premier minister of the state that
a premier team of the league
The premier team of the league that

answers.why: premier 意为“首要”，1950 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件首要的首相”，此处作前置定语 a premier minister of the state。
premier 意为“首要”，此处用 so premier that 结构，说它首要到渔港里没人敢靠近。
premier 意为“首要”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的首要国家的首相，等于最高级的说法。
premier 意为“首要”，母亲认为这件东西“太首要了，谁也用不上”，too premier to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩最负盛名的头名球队”，此处作前置定语 a premier team of the league。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩联赛中的头名球队一样最负盛名”，同级比较用 as premier as。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“最负盛名的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something premier。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当最负盛名”，quite 修饰原级 premier。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，no less premier than 表示“其最负盛名不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之最负盛名不亚于任何人的预料。
premier 意为“最负盛名”，母亲 1962 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的最负盛名头名球队”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件首要的首相。（a premier minister of the state）
它首要到渔港里没有一个人敢靠近。（so premier that …）
母亲觉得它太首要，谁也用不上。（too premier to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩最负盛名的头名球队。（a premier team of the league）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩联赛中的头名球队一样最负盛名。（as premier as …）
到了 1957 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件最负盛名的东西。（something premier）
answers: In 1950 the fisherman wrote of a premier minister of the state in the logbook.
It was so premier that nobody in the harbour would go near it.
My mother thought it too premier to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a premier team of the league.
He said nobody would call it as premier as the team of the league they had once had.
By 1957 the logbook asked for nothing but something premier.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 premier 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the fisherman wrote of a premier minister of the state in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the premier minister of the state that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too premier to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a premier team of the league, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite premier, and everybody laughed.
The premier ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
